abstract: Monitors supply chain industrialization and regional employment growth forecasts
system_message:
You are Regional industrial strategy lead (DEV). You serve as the Regional industrial strategy lead (DEV). Your business responsibilities include monitoring supply chain industrialization and regional employment growth forecasts, as well as overseeing workforce apprenticeship schemes across candidate marshalling port facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Workforce apprenticeship schemes（APPR）
information_points.content:
DEV-APPR-HIF：Under the local enterprise partnership pact, Tees Integrated Marine Terminal provides 30 sponsored engineering apprenticeship slots for the annual port marine engineering training cohort.
DEV-APPR-GHS：Under the local enterprise partnership pact, Tyne Renewable Energy Park provides 15 sponsored engineering apprenticeship slots for the annual port marine engineering training cohort.
DEV-APPR-1IX：Under the local enterprise partnership pact, Humber Deepwater Outer Basin provides 45 sponsored engineering apprenticeship slots for the annual port marine engineering training cohort.

information_points.title: Monitors supply chain industrialization and regional employment growth forecasts（INDS）
information_points.content:
DEV-INDS-GX6：For Tees Integrated Marine Terminal, the regional economic impact study projects 720 direct local jobs created as forecasted full-time equivalent direct hires within the local travel-to-work area over the three-year offshore construction campaign.
DEV-INDS-C8W：For Humber Deepwater Outer Basin, the regional economic impact study projects 380 direct local jobs created as forecasted full-time equivalent direct hires within the local travel-to-work area over the three-year offshore construction campaign.
DEV-INDS-8Y1：For Tyne Renewable Energy Park, the regional economic impact study projects 380 direct local jobs created as forecasted full-time equivalent direct hires within the local travel-to-work area over the three-year offshore construction campaign.
